scope: CPU-only end-to-end compatibility probe with a five-update pipeline-test network, not either full training arm or a strength evaluation.
inference_profile: one CPU thread, no GPU; original Cython rules/legal backend; named numeric NPZ arrays loaded with allow_pickle=False

replay.scope: Post-match replay using pinned native referee; t fields are measured wall times rounded to milliseconds. Each clock check allows +/-0.5ms measurement rounding; ambiguous margins are reported, never silently certified. This verifies records, not statistical superiority or all-engine coverage.
